description: We are a passionate and creative team interested in innovation, technology, and problem-solving. Our goal is to develop unique ideas and create solutions for real-world problems. We are looking for enthusiastic, dedicated, and creative team members with skills in programming, research, design, communication, and teamwork. Let's learn, innovate, and build something impactful together!
summary: A Space Mission Design Game is an interactive simulation where players design, manage, and operate a full space mission—choosing spacecraft components, instruments, launch vehicles, orbits, and budgets—using realistic NASA-inspired constraints and data.
